checks.expected_fact: Controller exposes GET /api/v1/todos (class mapping line 28 plus @GetMapping line 37).
checks.actual_result: Graph contains EXPOSES service:todoapp -> endpoint:todoapp:GET /api/v1/todos with evidence at controller lines 37-38.
Graph contains OWNS service:todoapp -> table:todoapp/todos with schema.sql line 1 evidence.

checks.expected_fact: GET /api/users listing invokes UserService.getAllUsers(), which calls UserRepository.findAll() and reads app_user.
checks.actual_result: Graph has GET /api/users -> app_user REACHES edge; controller evidence line 31 and repository evidence line 8. Pinned UserService.getAllUsers() calls userRepository.findAll() at line 24.

checks.expected_fact: RestClient GET to /api/v3/klines uses configured Binance base URL https://api.binance.com.
checks.actual_result: Graph contains CALLS service:assistant -> external:api.binance.com; evidence at BinanceClient.java:38 and :23 plus application.properties:14.

checks.expected_fact: POST /fhir is exposed using class @RequestMapping(value="/fhir") and method @PostMapping.
checks.actual_result: Graph contains EXPOSES service:fhir-gateway -> endpoint:fhir-gateway:POST /fhir with evidence at FhirController.java:58-59.

checks.expected_fact: Cloud Stream process-in-0 consumes topic fhir.all (default of KAFKA_INPUT_TOPICS).
checks.actual_result: Graph contains CONSUMES service:fhir-gateway -> topic:fhir.all, via cloud-stream:process-in-0, with application.yml line 77 evidence.

checks.expected_fact: Configured function binding consumes topic fhir-msg (TOPIC default).
checks.actual_result: Graph contains CONSUMES service:fhir-to-server -> topic:fhir-msg; application.yml evidence lines 39 and 49 represent the single/batch bindings.

checks.expected_fact: Router is nested under path("/api"); GET /franchises/{franchiseId}/top-products therefore resolves as /api/franchises/{franchiseId}/top-products.
checks.actual_result: Source nests route tree in nest(path("/api"), ...) at lines 193-194; GET predicate is at line 203. Graph reports GET /franchises/{franchiseId}/top-products with EXACT evidence line 203, omitting /api.

checks.expected_fact: POST /api/signup invokes signup service and persists User through UserRepository.save.
checks.actual_result: Graph contains REACHES endpoint POST /api/signup -> table user, evidence UserController.java:26 and UserRepository.java:9; pinned service saves at UserService.java:44.

checks.expected_fact: SqsTemplate.send publishes the message to the configured SQS queue; graph would need a queue/message edge to represent this call.
checks.actual_result: No SQS queue or messaging edge appears in this graph. Scanner messaging extraction supports Kafka, RabbitMQ, and RocketMQ patterns; AWS SqsTemplate is outside current support, so this checked fact is unsupported rather than a miss.

checks.expected_fact: RestTemplate POST to Safaricom Daraja STK push URL calls external host sandbox.safaricom.co.ke and path /mpesa/stkpush/v1/processrequest.
checks.actual_result: Graph contains CALLS service:scentcepts -> external:sandbox.safaricom.co.ke with POST path /mpesa/stkpush/v1/processrequest, evidence at PaymentEventListener.java:87.
Graph contains EXPOSES service:dugout -> endpoint:dugout:GET /api/players with evidence at PlayerController.java:13-14.

definite_bugs.title: Nested WebFlux nest(path(...)) prefix is omitted
definite_bugs.symptom: Graph emits paths such as /franchises/... although the entire RouterFunction is nested under path("/api"); actual paths begin /api/.
definite_bugs.implementation_area: InboundHttpExtractor.functionalRoutes currently recognizes inline route()/andRoute() calls but does not compose enclosing RouterFunctions.nest path predicates.
definite_bugs.minimal_repro: @Bean RouterFunction<ServerResponse> routes(H h) { return nest(path("/api"), route(GET("/items"), h::get)); } Expected GET /api/items, not /items.
